finding.claim: Path traversal in /dl: the unsanitized query parameter f is joined to root, and filepath.Join cleans '..' segments, so f=../../etc/passwd resolves outside /srv/files. An unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary files readable by the process.
finding.sink: os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)) at files.go:13, with the contents written to the response at files.go:18

trace.note: name := r.URL.Query().Get("f") is attacker-controlled and unvalidated
filepath.Join("/srv/files", "../../etc/passwd") cleans to "/etc/passwd", which escapes root; ReadFile opens it
File contents are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: No filepath.Base, no prefix check after Clean, no rejection of '..' or absolute paths, no authentication or authorization middleware, and no use of os.Root or fs.FS. The handler is registered directly at files.go:32. Not mitigated.

verdict.reason: files.go:12-13 pass the raw query param f to os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)) with no Base, prefix check or auth, so f=../../etc/passwd escapes /srv/files and files.go:18 returns the contents to an anonymous caller via the handler registered at files.go:32.
